attributes.description: Duration period for validity checks

objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not require formal approval

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the additional information object

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Brief instructions, photos, screenshots or other supplementary information

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or draft

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning through the main document release process

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the attachment object

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Supplementary document content

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number synchronized with main document

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Whether attachment is archived

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed modification to an existing document created by authorized users without affecting the current version

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the change proposal

attributes.name: proposed_changes
attributes.description: Description of suggested modifications

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the proposal - pending or scheduled for implementation

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Creator of the change proposal

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to review and extend document validity when approaching expiration

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when validity extension request is created

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document being reviewed

attributes.name: days_before_expiration
attributes.description: Number of days before validity expires when request is generated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that has lost its validity

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when override request is created

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document to be invalidated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request

attributes.name: archive_start_date
attributes.description: Date when archiving period begins

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to restore a previously invalidated document to active status

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when reactivation request is created

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: Reference to the document to be reactivated

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Creator of the reactivation request from Business Admin group

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the reactivation request

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with assigned permissions and roles for document access

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role type such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user in the system with assigned roles and permissions

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the person

attributes.name: role

attributes.name: name
